cards.card_text: It tastes like wafers made with honey.
cards.verse_text: It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.
cards.snippet: It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.

cards.card_text: He's also to fill a basket with unleavened bread, cakes mixed with oil and wafers anointed with oil, all made from fine wheat flour, and present it with the bull and the rams.
cards.verse_text: “Now this is what you are to do to consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish, along with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
cards.snippet: …blemish, along with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

cards.card_text: Back to the second ram, the ram for ordination: Moses is to put its fat and right thigh, plus one loaf, one cake and one wafer from the basket, in the hands of Aaron and his sons.
cards.verse_text: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination), along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
cards.snippet: …loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.

cards.card_text: If someone offers it in thanksgiving, he brings unleavened cakes, unleavened wafers, cakes of fine flour and cakes of leavened bread with it, and one portion of each goes to the priest who sprinkles the blood.
cards.verse_text: Now this is the law of the peace offering that one may present to the LORD: If he offers it in thanksgiving, then along with the sacrifice of thanksgiving he shall offer unleavened cakes mixed with olive oil, unleavened wafers coated with oil, and well-kneaded cakes of fine flour mixed with oil.
cards.snippet: …of thanksgiving he shall offer unleavened cakes mixed with olive oil, unleavened wafers coated with oil, and well-kneaded cakes of fine flour mixed with oil.

cards.card_text: From the basket of unleavened bread before the LORD, he takes one cake of unleavened bread, one cake made with oil and one wafer, and places them on top.
cards.verse_text: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one cake of unleavened bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer, and he placed them on the fat portions and on the right thigh.
cards.snippet: …of unleavened bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer, and he placed them on the fat portions and on the right…

cards.card_text: Then come the offerings, and they just KEEP coming: an unblemished male lamb, female lamb and ram, with grain and drink offerings and a basket of unleavened cakes and wafers.
cards.verse_text: and he is to present an offering to the LORD of an unblemished year-old male lamb as a burnt offering, an unblemished year-old female lamb as a sin offering, and an unblemished ram as a peace offering— together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—and a basket of unleavened cakes made from fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers coated with oil.
cards.snippet: …of unleavened cakes made from fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers coated with oil.

cards.card_text: The priest puts the ram's boiled shoulder, one unleavened cake and one unleavened wafer into the Nazirite's hands.
cards.verse_text: And the priest is to take the boiled shoulder from the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them into the hands of the Nazirite who has just shaved the hair of his consecration.
cards.snippet: …from the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them into the hands of the Nazirite who has just…

cards.card_text: Then the job list gets to the bread: the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering and the wafers of unleavened bread.
cards.verse_text: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
cards.snippet: …rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity…

cards.card_text: Along with the showbread, the fine flour and the wafers, what else does the job list give the Levites?
cards.verse_text: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
